defaultModeDecision.sourceRef: visualEvidence.visualMood and visualEvidence.observedColors dark mixed combat tones
defaultModeDecision.rationale: No explicit user theme preference was given. Research visual evidence describes zombie survival combat with darker scenes balanced by bright fruit/reward accents, so dark is the default for first paint.

sourceEvidence.notes: Green fruit/survival cue from official icon and Roblox artwork.
Purple grape/event cue from Roblox title emoji and fruit branding context.
Darker combat tones and zombie survival mood from official screenshots/key art.

rationale: Use a high-contrast dark action-survival interface with fruit-green primary actions, purple reward/event accents, and restrained danger red for failed/expired states. The visual language should feel like Roblox anime action without copying competitor layouts or colors.

contrastRequirements.stateCues: Every status such as active, expired, stale, verified or warning must include text label or icon plus color.

gameVisualLanguage.typography: Bold readable sans for HUD-like headings; neutral sans for guide body text.
gameVisualLanguage.shapes: Compact panels, sharp 6-8px radii, strong outlines for tables and status chips.
gameVisualLanguage.assetRules: Use official Roblox icon/key art only after rights/source and crop verification; avoid inherited template artwork.
gameVisualLanguage.heroAssetGate: Hero media must depict this game from official Roblox thumbnails or verified in-game screenshots and pass desktop/mobile crop review.
forbiddenPatterns: template game artwork from another title

faviconDirection.concept: Simplified fruit-versus-zombie survival icon derived from the official Roblox game icon crop, reduced to one bold fruit shape and one survival bite cue.
faviconDirection.silhouette: Large round fruit silhouette with a small contrasting bite/slash mark, centered in a square icon.
faviconDirection.generationPromptEnglish: Create a 512x512 PNG favicon for a Roblox Fruit Zombie Survival guide site: one bold green fruit silhouette with a simple purple survival bite accent, dark background, high contrast, clean vector-like edges, strong outline.
faviconDirection.foreground: Green fruit silhouette with purple accent based on official visual evidence.
faviconDirection.background: Dark survival backdrop matching the site dark token.
smallSizeRules: At 16x16 keep only the round fruit silhouette and single bite accent.
Use flat shapes and remove decorative marks before ICO export.
